Produce the implementation plan.

The failing regression test precedes the implementation change

evals.prompt: Produce the implementation plan without requesting more detail; every statement below is exact approved contract. Begin by explicitly classifying authorization, persistent permissions, and the public API interface individually as High risk factors. AC-001 denies access when the requested permission is absent. AC-002 backfills stored permissions from the current effective permissions in one transaction and aborts on any mismatch. AC-003 returns both the old `permissions` field and new `effectivePermissions` field for one release. The approved FULL SOLUTION changes auth/policy.js first, then auth/permissions-repository.js, then api/permissions-route.js. Discovery established security tests via `node --test test/security` and full regression via `node --test`. Approved rollback disables the new rule, restores the pre-migration permission snapshot, and keeps the old field; verification must prove deny-by-default, migration integrity, old-client compatibility, and rollback restoration.
evals.expected_output: The plan treats the change Deep/high risk, orders risk-first verification, and stops for explicit plan approval before BUILD.
expectations: Classifies the authorization, persistence, and public-interface factors as High
Uses narrower dependency-ordered tasks and security-focused verification
Requires explicit plan approval before BUILD
